name: category_military
prompt: Attached images are approved original villager/guard STYLE and MATERIAL references. Create one NEW small game UI icon of the guards ancient Greek ROUND shield, simple muted royal-blue PAINTED WOOD face with slender dull bronze rim, and one spear ENTIRELY BEHIND the shield diagonally. The central spear shaft is completely OCCLUDED by shield; only spearhead above upper-right and handle BELOW lower-left outer edge may show. NO shaft drawn on top of the blue face. Blue face uses two quiet PAINTED CEL tones like the guard shield/cloak: broad muted blue and one very restrained blue shadow shape. The blue is matte pigment on wood, NOT reflective metal, no hotspot, specular reflection, shiny rim, spherical gradient or bevel rendering. Small sparse handmade wash variation allowed, fine thin brown pen contours, no decorative marks, no individual planks, no heraldry. Clean readable24/32px isolated icon. White background, no shadow or text. Era constraint: ancient Greek Mediterranean setting. Depict plausible ancient materials, clothing, tools, vessels and architecture. No magnetic compass, compass rose/needle, telescope, sextant, modern globe/cartographic markings, GPS routes, modern location pins, medieval heraldry, modern footwear construction or modern clothing cuffs. Do not invent writing. Abstract action arrows/checks are UI glyphs, not historical equipment. Preserve required gameplay meaning without inventing an exact date. Style constraint: painted Studio Ghibli-leaning cel art matching the retained original villager. Two gentle tonal areas, broad quiet color, fine sparse brown ink, very restrained hand-painted variation and small soft highlights are allowed. Do not turn it into a sterile vector diagram. No glossy/PBR/specular material rendering, dense texture noise, fur strands or bevels. Preserve subject hue separation and readable silhouette; approved villager and primary diorama are style authority, subject references only lock geometry.
